scope: Local pixel and name audit only. All 105 actual image files were visually inspected in category sheets at up to 700px width; images taller than 850px at that width were segmented. G private parties, D hero and F food additionally opened at native resolution. No browser/source edits or catalog mutations performed.
limitations: Pixels establish whether the asset shows the named component. They cannot establish whether a source issue, loading/animation state, full-page capture bug or crop geometry caused a defect; live comparison is required. No interaction or submission behavior tested.
